description: Going prices for a product: median, middle half and median MOQ across all priced listings in matching product categories, with the US import duty where known, and declared_import_price: the unit price importers declared to Chile's customs for the same HS6 code from China. Give hs6 (your classification of the product) to get that declared price for the code too; it is the only price when no product category matches. Free; does not spend a search.

hs6.description: The six-digit HS code you'd classify the product under, e.g. 340600 for candles. Give it whenever you can: it adds the unit price importers declared to customs for that code, the only price when no product category matches.
